text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — SwiftEdge renewal in ~3 weeks. We saw a sharp drop in activity starting Wed (embeddings + API calls). Procurement moved to R. Liang last week and they haven’t signed the SOW. Need quick triage, possible renewal risk.

devon_se: Looking now. Preliminary numbers: ~62% drop in generate_tokens and ~70% drop in embedding calls over last 7d vs prior week. Most traffic gap is from prod-org 'swiftedge-prod'.

devon_se: ```sql
-- quick metric pull (internal)
SELECT env, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(distinct user_id) as active_users
FROM usage_events
WHERE org = 'swiftedge-prod' AND ts > now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY env;
```

akshay_account: Confirmed on my side — had sync with their ML lead yesterday. They paused a bunch of pipelines after they noticed latency regressions following last quantized model rollout on Dedicated. They’re also running a short pilot with a competitor (NimbusAI) focused on latency/cost. Procurement asked for perf numbers + a price comparison yesterday.

julia_csm: Ok. I can host a customer triage today. Proposed options to surface: revert to last stable model, enable prefix caching, or a temporary dedicated capacity bump. Also propose a 2-week trial extension while we stabilize.

devon_se: Quick smoke test results: rolling back to previous model drops p50 latency from ~380ms -> ~120ms on sample traffic (same batch). I can prep a canary revert and perf graphs for the call.

ops-bot: calendar: "SwiftEdge renewal triage" scheduled today 15:30 PST — invites sent to maria_cs, julia_csm, devon_se, akshay_account. Customer contact r.liang@swiftedge.com included.

maria_cs: Action items before call:
1) devon -> present rollback plan + perf deltas and risk of KV cache mismatch.
2) julia -> lead renewal ask + draft a 2-week extension offer and usage report.
3) akshay -> surface top failing prompts and any customer reproductions.
4) simon_sales -> standby for concession ask. :eyes:

simon_sales: If they push on price for Dedicated bump we can offer a temporary 10% credit for 2 months or 30% off the bump for the trial window. I’ll prep approval matrix.

akshay_account: I’ll also pull request traces and a couple failing prompt examples to attach to the ticket.

maria_cs: Thanks team — please join the 15:30 call. I’ll update this thread after the sync with the agreed next steps. If anyone sees further usage degradation before then, ping me directly or escalate to #customer-ops-urgent. :exclamation:
